description: This file contains benchmarking code for performance testing of Orleans wire protocol field header encoding and writing. It defines a class 'FieldHeaderBenchmarks' with methods to measure various aspects of writing field headers and bytes using Orleans serialization infrastructure.

classes.name: FieldHeaderBenchmarks
classes.description: A benchmarking class designed to measure performance of Orleans wire protocol field header encoding and writing.

methods.name: WritePlainExpectedEmbeddedId
methods.description: Benchmarks writing a field header with a small field id suitable for embedded encoding.

methods.name: WritePlainExpectedExtendedId
methods.description: Benchmarks writing a field header with a large field id delta, using extended encoding.

methods.name: WriteFastEmbedded
methods.description: Benchmarks a fast method to write a field header expected for small embedded id.

methods.name: WriteFastExtended
methods.description: Benchmarks a fast method to write a field header with extended id delta.

methods.name: CreateWriter
methods.description: Benchmark for creating a new writer object.

methods.name: WriteByte
methods.description: Benchmark for writing a single byte.
